name: Builders Risk and Project Organizer
summary: Assemble project value, parties, duration, and contract requirements for a builders risk placement.

spec.user: An owner, general contractor, or developer preparing a builders risk placement.
authoritativeSources: Published builders risk form provisions cited by form and edition
California Civil Code anti-indemnity sections where relevant
spec.privacyBoundary: No project addresses, no party names, no contract documents.
decisionRules: This tool never states that a risk is eligible, ineligible, standard market, non-admitted, FAIR Plan eligible, bound, or uninsurable. It shows the published pathway criteria and names who actually decides, which is the insurer.
spec.uncertainty: Builders risk is often written on manuscript forms, so terms vary widely.
spec.output: A printable project organizer with the requirements and open questions.
exportFormat: PDF via the browser print dialog
spec.updateCadence: Reviewed at least every 180 days, and immediately when a cited source changes.
